title: Red Cabbage Slaw with Tarragon Cream
blurb: Finely sliced red cabbage and onion dressed in a tangy tarragon cream, ready in minutes.
steps: Remove the outer leaves from the cabbage, quarter it and cut out the core, then slice the quarters as finely as you can.
Peel and halve the red onion, then slice it very thinly into half-moons.
Put the cabbage and onion in a large bowl and add the salt, then massage with your hands for a minute to soften the vegetables slightly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cream, balsamic vinegar, tarragon and black pepper until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage and onion, then toss everything together until evenly coated.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, then serve straight away or chill for up to an hour to let the flavours develop.
